affordances.semantic: 20 small spheres representing gas molecules bouncing inside a container

affordances.name: Container
locator_hints: wireframe or semi-transparent box at origin

checks.expr: (() => { const hs=["#heat-btn"]; const all=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('body *')); const text=(tag,value)=>all.some(el=>(!tag||el.tagName.toLowerCase()===tag)&&String(el.textContent||'').trim().toLowerCase().includes(value.toLowerCase())); return hs.some(raw=>{ const h=String(raw).trim(); if(!h)return false; try { if(document.querySelector(h))return true; } catch {} const id=h.replace(/^#/,''); if(/^[A-Za-z][\w:.-]*$/.test(id)&&document.getElementById(id))return true; const quoted=h.match(/^(?:([a-z]+)\s+)?(?:with\s+)?text\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]$/i)||h.match(/^([a-z]+)\s+labeled\s+['"]([^'"]+)['"]$/i); if(quoted&&text((quoted[1]||'').toLowerCase(),quoted[2]))return true; const label=h.match(/^(.*?)(?:\s+button|\s+slider|\s+panel)$/i); return label ? text('',label[1]) : text('',h); }); })()
